decision: The stable solver satisfies every numerical optimality invariant, so the held-out miss is valid. Close the fixed-attention analytic coefficient mechanism. Authorize an architecture review for a variable-rank host that widens only layer 1 to the measured rank 1044, initializes from this stable analytic solution, and jointly fits that layer's existing attention and nonlinear coefficient machinery for one fixed-coverage epoch. Do not widen all layers or change data, ridge, route, optimizer, epoch, source, or gates.
claim_boundary: Negative stable rank-1044 analytic coefficient realizability evidence only; no installed model, physical runtime, autonomous quality, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
